svg.text: First ask who decides the next step: code (workflows) or the LLM (agents). Five

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: composable workflow patterns, reason-and-act loops like ReAct and Reflexion, and

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: context tricks like compaction and masking are the building blocks. Pi shows how little

font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 先问：下一步由谁决定？代码（工作流）还是 LLM（智能体）。五种可组合的工作流模式、ReAct 和

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: Reflexion 这类推理-行动循环，以及压缩、遮蔽等上下文技巧，是基本积木。Pi 说明一个运行框架

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 其实只需要很少的东西。
